name: codebase-map
description: /map builds a compact map of your repository and gives it to Claude.

autoInject.title: Give the map to Claude every turn
autoInject.description: Adds the saved map to Claude's system prompt on every request, once /map has run in this project.

depth.title: Tree depth
depth.description: How many directory levels the tree shows (1-6). Lowered automatically when the map would exceed maxChars.

maxChars.title: Size cap (characters)
maxChars.description: The most characters the map may take (1000-40000).
